why: The swap a member can add to their Ritual after letting something go: only rows whose fits_instead is a thing to do, not an adjustment to what they already do. Title is the part's name; slot is when it sits; per_week blank means every day.

work-email-after-9pm: One evening email check, then notifications off
checking-the-sleep-score-every-morning: A weekly look at sleep trends
emf-blockers-anti-radiation-stickers: Phone across the room at night
grounding-earthing-sheets-mats: Barefoot time on grass or sand
salt-lamp: A warm, dim lamp in the evening
5-htp: A short worry list before bed
bone-broth: A mug of miso or homemade stock
